transitions.transition: Singleton restores minimized existing window and optionally sends explicit view. Focus is conditional on !isBackgroundLaunch(), not unconditional; getDashboardPopoutWindow separately rejects destroyed webContents.

persist: 500ms-debounced save of getBounds() on resize/move; skipped when closing/destroyed/minimized/fullscreen or below minimum; close and app before-quit freeze the timer
close: singleton nulled only if identical instance; zoom listener unsubscribed; open=false broadcast
main-close authority: closeDashboardPopout() closes popout so it never orphans without the main window
identity: popout uses isolated partition, webviewTag false, and is deliberately NOT stamped with a browser-host id; every client-placed page is a mirror to this renderer
zoom authority: popout follows app-wide uiZoomLevel changes but keeps window-local zoom until the app level actually changes

popout-to-main relay: ack/reveal/spawn/sleep admitted only from live popout renderer with validated args; revealAgent raises the main window via safelyRevealWindow

500ms debounce, skip when closing/destroyed/fullscreen. Maximized updates only windowMaximized:true; near-min updates only windowMaximized:false, preserving previous bounds. attach first snapshots/validates inventory and protocol dependencies, then checks foreign device/admission. Restore calls observeInventory; replacement allocates a global host generation, fences old, creates/registers state. Detailed imported ledger/tunnel/reconciliation internals remain owned review debt.

restore requires active/reconnecting, reconnect v1 both sides, equal command/reconciliation versions and capability arrays equal by LENGTH+ORDER (not set equality). Active restore fences routes/detaches delivery. Swaps connection fence/token; replaces inventory with newly supplied snapshot or empty array, not old inventory. File channel renegotiated independently. Same epoch/generation retained.

disconnect: no-op unless registry-current, token-current, and active; legacy (no reconnect v1) fences immediately; else reconnecting + reconciliation fenced + routes fenced + grace timer armed (default 15000ms at registry.ts:98) ending in fence released
release: explicit revocation fences only the token-current lease; terminal for that generation

graceMs must be positive integer. Old handle release checks connection token; final registry-current token guard lives in fence dispatch/fencing. First fence reason wins. Loss of a lease is authority revocation, not proof of guest/process exit.
